lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCr₂(OF)₄ crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with a 36-atom unit cell (Mg₃Cr₆O₁₂F₁₂) and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cr and Mg centers, each coordinated by three F and three O neighbors, alongside tetrahedral F centers. Corner-sharing is observed between Cr and Mg octahedra and between Cr octahedra and F tetrahedra, with edge-sharing between Cr and Mg octahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
